## SharePoint

The [REG SharePoint](https://uob.sharepoint.com/teams/grp-ResearchEngineering/Shared Documents/Forms/All.aspx) contains key documents and resources related to REG, including details of meetings, presentations and reading group material. Access to the REG Sharepoint can be granted if you have opportunity to contribute to this shared resource.

## GitHub

The REG has a [GitHub organisation](https://github.com/Bristol-REG) has collective repositories which can be contributed to (including *this* repository).

Additional repositories include:
 - [REG "Today I learned" repository](https://github.com/Bristol-REG/TIL) - used to share new things within the REG group that would be useful for others (including our future self!) to see.

You can request access by contacting us at [jgi-reseng@bristol.ac.uk](jgi-reseng@bristol.ac.uk).
Whilst at the University you can also access [additional education benefits](https://education.github.com/) on GitHub.
